2. Heard Sri Pradeep Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Imran Khan, learned AGA, for the State.
3. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.15 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366 and 376 (2)N IPC and Section 5J(2)/6, 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Fatehganj Poorvi, District Bareilly during pendency of the trial.
4. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and one another under Section 366 IPC and according to the FIR, informant performed marriage of his daughter with one Sushil and after marriage when informant has taken her to his home then applicant with the help of his friend Ravi enticed her away.
sentences._hearing_file: Vijay vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 19 September, 2023.json

It is further mentioned in the FIR that the daughter of the informant has also Vijay vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145678788/

5. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and actually marriage of the victim was performed with another person against her wishes and as she loved the applicant and,
therefore, even after marriage she had gone along with applicant and after performing marriage with him started living with him.
6.

He further submits that as per the school record victim was around 17-1/2 years old girl but during investigation her ossification test could not be conducted and as she is more than 17 years old even as per her school record, therefore, precisely at this stage it cannot be said that she was below 18 years of age.
8.
sentences._hearing_file: Vijay vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 19 September, 2023.json

sentences.text: He further submits that it is a case of love affair and applicant in the present matter is in jail since 2.7.2023.

sentences.text: 9. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayerfor bail and submits that as per school record victim was around 17 years old and, therefore, her consent is immaterial but he could not dispute the fact that in her both the statements recorded during investigation victim categorically stated that she according to her own wish had gone along with applicant and also performed marriage with him.
sentences._hearing_file: Vijay vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 19 September, 2023.json

sentences.text: 10. Learned AGA further could not dispute the fact that even marriage of the victim had been performed with some other person against her wishes.

sentences.text:
However, he further submits that applicant is having criminal history of Sections 394 and 411 IPC.
11.

sentences.text: I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
sentences._hearing_file: Vijay vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 19 September, 2023.json

sentences.text: 12. Although applicant is having criminal history of Sections 394 and 411 IPC and as per school record victim appears to be around 17 years old at the time of incident but from the record it reflects that the marriage of the victim was performed with some other person against her wishes and thereafter she had gone along with applicant and after performing marriage with him started living with him and she did not make any allegation against the applicant in her both the statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.
sentences._hearing_file: Vijay vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 19 September, 2023.json

sentences.text: The present case appears to be a case of love affair.
sentences._hearing_file: Vijay vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 19 September, 2023.json

sentences.text:
13. The law is settled that if otherwise case of bail is made out then merely on the basis of criminal history, bail should not be dismissed and further, bail application should not be dismissed either for punitive or preventive purposes.
14.

sentences.text:
Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
